svg.aria-label: Looks like a GitHub contribution graph, until the squares fly into the windows of a Canarian town under Teide at golden hour, next to a beach cove. A red Renault Clio IV drives the coast road past signs: 2015 retail and customer service, 2023 technical support L1, 2024 L2 support, incident manager and lead management, hobbies gym, board games and series, films and anime, billboards for Kanbate, Kage and PRM, then the next exit, AI, into a tunnel. Five cats nap, sit and play football along the way.
